episodes.title: Dominus
episodes.summary: Having no memory of his downfall in "Spartacus: Vengeance," Ashur wakes to find himself the owner of the former House of Batiatus; eager to earn the respect and power he's always desired, Ashur must save face by presenting something new to the arena.

episodes.title: Forsaken
episodes.summary: Ashur navigates the treacherous waters of the Roman elites while Achillia struggles to acclimate to the brutal life of a gladiator in training.

episodes.title: Unworthy
episodes.summary: Korris faces Ashur's wrath and must prove himself worthy.

episodes.title: Blood and Bone
episodes.summary: Ashur desperately maneuvers to secure a place in the upcoming games of the Ludi Apollinares before the imminent arrival of Marcus Crassus.

episodes.title: Goddess of Death
episodes.summary: Ashur presents Achillia to the public, where she faces her first battle in the arena.

episodes.title: Empty Things
episodes.summary: Ashur's popularity within Capua soars. But at a devastating cost.

episodes.title: Deepest Wound
episodes.summary: Korris demands blood. Ashur attempts to sway an enemy toward his cause.

episodes.title: Horizons
episodes.summary: Achillia prepares for her return to the arena, while Ashur faces a devastating setback.

episodes.title: Those Who Remain
episodes.summary: Caesar demands a painful sacrifice from Ashur.

episodes.title: Hail Caesar
episodes.summary: Achillia returns to the arena to face her greatest challenge, while Ashur wrestles with the emotional fallout of his actions.
